retrieved_lessons.rationale: Those rules are about not re-paying a stalled 10-year backup or a SOFR contract that stopped confirming it. This ticket receives the confirmed 2-year downtrend instead of re-shorting 10s or SOFR.

That rule is about not adding to a March SOFR pay when implied drifts lower against a live ten-year backup. This ticket receives March SOFR with the ten-year already down 35bp over one month, so the confirming coupon tape is lower yields, not a pay.
